rest-module-personaldashboard.v0-title: API-ga Guddiga Gaarka ah ee Isticmaalaha
rest-module-personaldashboard.v0-desc: Quudinnada hawlaha ugu dambeeyay ee qaybaha Guddiga Gaarka ah ee Isticmaalaha
personal-dashboard-rest-endpoint-summary: Ka hel waxyaabaha quudinta ilaha la codsaday
personal-dashboard-rest-endpoint-desc-fe: Wuxuu soo celiyaa quudin la isku daray oo ka kooban waxyaabo laga soo ururiyay ilaha la codsaday, iyadoo kuwa ugu cusub ay ugu horreeyaan.
personal-dashboard-rest-param-desc-feed-: [Ilaha quudinta](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:PersonalDashboard/API#Sources) laga soo ururinayo, oo lagu kala saaray `|`. Waxyaabaha si siman ayaa loogu qaybiyaa ilahaas.
Tirada ugu badan ee waxyaabaha la soo celinayo
Calaamad qarsoon oo laga helay jawaab hore, si loo soo helo bogga xiga ee isla quudinta.
personal-dashboard-rest-schema-desc-feed: Quudinta, iyadoo kuwa ugu cusub ay ugu horreeyaan, si simanna loogu qaybiyay ilaha la codsaday.
Calaamadda dib loogu gudbinayo sida `continue` si loo helo bogga xiga. Ma jiri doonto marka dhammaan ilaha la dhammeeyo.

Magacyada ilaha aan awoodin inay akhriyaan dhammaan xogta ay ka kooban yihiin, sidaas darteed waxyaabaha qaarkood ayaa laga yaabaa inay maqnaadaan. Ma jiri doonaan marka dhammaan ilaha si buuxda loo akhriyo.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-id: Aqoonsiga shaygan, kaas oo gaar u ah dhammaan ilaha ku jira hal jawaab.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-fe: Magaca isha quudinta ee shaygani ka yimid.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-re: Aqoonsiga dib u eegista ee wax-ka-beddelkan.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ol: Aqoonsiga dib u eegista uu wax ka beddelkani ka yimid, ama `null` haddii wax ka beddelku abuuray bogga.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-us: Magaca isticmaalaha sameeyay wax ka beddelka, ama cinwaankiisa IP-ga haddii aanu akoonkiisa ku jirin.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ti: Waqtiga wax-ka-beddelka la sameeyay, qaabka ISO 8601.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ne: Cabbirka bogga kadib wax ka beddelka, oo lagu cabbiray bayt.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ol: Cabbirka bogga ka hor wax ka beddelka, oo lagu cabbiray bayt.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-pa: Soo koobidda wax ka beddelka oo ah HTML la falanqeeyay. Madhan haddii soo koobiddu kaa qarsoon tahay.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-de: Sharaxaad kooban oo ku saabsan bogga. Madhan haddii boggu aanu lahayn.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-mi: Sharaxaad kooban oo ku saabsan bogga. Madhan haddii boggu aanu lahayn.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-bo: In wax ka beddelka uu sameeyay bot.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ne: In wax ka beddelku abuuray bogga.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ta: Calaamadaha lagu dabaqay wax ka beddelka.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-or: Dhibcaha barashada mashiinka ee wax ka beddelka, iyadoo loo kala saaray moodeelka iyo qaybta. Madhan haddii wax ka beddelku aanu lahayn.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-th: Cinwaanka bogga ay dooddu ku saabsan tahay.
Aqoonsiga bogga ay dooddu ku saabsan tahay.
Waqtiga faalladii ugu dambaysay ee doodda la sameeyay, qaabka ISO 8601.
Cinwaanka qaybta ay dooddu hoos timaaddo, qoraal caadi ah ahaan.
Qaybta xiriirisa cinwaanka qaybta ee bogga. Madhan haddii cinwaanka qaybtu aanu lahayn.
Cinwaanka doodda ay dooddan hoos timaaddo, ama `null` haddii ay horeba u tahay dood heerka koowaad ah.
Tirada faallooyinka hoos yimaada cinwaanka qaybta, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa hoos yimaada cinwaannada qaybihiisa hoose.
Tirada dadka faallo ka bixiyay cinwaanka qaybta hoostiisa, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa faallo ka bixiyay qaybihiisa hoose.
Aqoonsiga faalladii ugu dambaysay ee doodda.
personal-dashboard-rest-feed-bad-continu: Qiimaha `continue` halkan laguma isticmaali karo. Mar kale codso quudinta adigoon ku darin.
